features.title: What You Can Track
features.subtitle: Real-time insights about your restaurant's online presence.

items.title: Daily Views, Scans & Visitor Trends
items.description: See how many people scan your QR code and visit your menu every day, week, and month. Track trends over time to understand seasonal patterns and measure the impact of promotions.

items.title: Language & Device Breakdown
items.description: Know which languages your guests prefer and which devices they use. This data helps you prioritize translations and ensure your menu looks perfect on the most popular devices.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Start tracking your restaurant's performance in four steps.

steps.title: Create Your Restaurant
steps.description: Analytics start tracking from the moment your menu goes live. There's nothing to configure — every page view, QR scan, and visitor is recorded automatically.

steps.title: Share Your QR Code
steps.description: Print your QR code and place it on tables, at the entrance, or on takeaway packaging. Every scan is recorded with timestamp, language, device, and page visited.

steps.title: Open the Analytics Dashboard
steps.description: See daily, weekly, and monthly statistics with clear charts. Track total views, unique visitors, and trends over time from a single dashboard screen.

steps.title: Explore Detailed Breakdowns
steps.description: View stats broken down by page (menu, contacts, reservations), preferred language, device type, and browser. Use this data to optimize your menu and prioritize translations.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about restaurant analytics.

items.question: What metrics can I track?
items.answer: Daily, weekly, and monthly page views. Unique visitors. Most viewed pages. Language preferences. Device and browser breakdown. All updated in real time.

items.question: Is analytics included in the free plan?
items.answer: Yes. Growth analytics are available on every plan, including free. You can see views, visitors, and language stats from day one.

items.question: Can I see which pages are most popular?
items.answer: Yes. The dashboard shows views broken down by page — home, menu, contacts, reservations, and language selection. See exactly where guests spend their time.

items.question: How far back does the data go?
items.answer: Analytics data is stored from the day you create your restaurant. You can view daily, weekly, and monthly trends for your entire history.

items.question: Do I need to add any tracking code?
items.answer: No. Analytics are built into your restaurant website automatically. Every page view and QR scan is tracked without any setup or code changes on your part.

items.question: Can I see which languages my guests prefer?
items.answer: Yes. The analytics dashboard shows a breakdown of languages used by your visitors. This helps you decide which translations to prioritize for your menu.

items.question: Does analytics affect my website's loading speed?
items.answer: No. Analytics tracking is lightweight and runs in the background. It has no noticeable impact on your menu's loading speed or guest experience.
